steps.title: Welcome to Merger Realm!
steps.body: Let's get your realm started. This will only take a minute.

steps.title: Summon a Unit
steps.body: Tap the Homestead to summon a new villager or woodsman.

steps.title: Food, Wood & Iron
steps.body: Your units generate food, wood, and iron over time. Spawning new units costs these resources, so keep an eye on your stockpile.

steps.title: Merge Two Units
steps.body: Drag one unit onto another of the same type and level to merge them into something stronger.

steps.title: Dismiss to the Prince
steps.body: Drag a unit onto the Prince to dismiss it from service. He'll gain leadership XP for it.

steps.title: Leadership XP
steps.body: Leadership XP levels up the Prince, unlocking new facilities and expanding your grid.

steps.title: The Wall Gate
steps.body: When rewards are waiting, tap the Gate in the wall to claim them onto your grid.

steps.title: Building
steps.body: Tap Build to construct new facilities using the tokens you collect from chests.

steps.title: You're Ready!
steps.body: Merge, spawn, and grow your realm. Good luck, Your Highness.

tips.title: A Monster Appeared!
tips.body: Drag one of your units onto it to fight back.

tips.title: Exploration
tips.body: Send a unit exploring to discover resources and rare loot over time.

tips.title: Raids
tips.body: Form a party and battle through raid chapters for exclusive rewards.

tips.title: Inventory
tips.body: Equip items and runes on your units here to make them stronger.
